name: Final Report
objective: Produce a structured report with provenance and limitations.
instructions: Produce the requested structured marine research report in JSON. Use only supplied evidence, measured summaries, and NOAA sources. Distinguish live data from interpretation; never claim ecosystem change from SST/chlorophyll association alone. Report data gaps and uncertainty. The application adds authoritative source metadata after validating your output.
error_handling: Return a stage error and preserve workflow provenance.
